zh-CN:
更新内容
• 全新首页：精选轮播、为你推荐、最近常听、换个流派听听等栏目，基于本地标签与音频特征的个性化推荐，可结合 Last.fm 相似信号；「换一批」降低重复；支持空库拖放导入，可设为启动默认入口
• 歌曲详情新增频谱页签：整曲声谱图，滚轮缩放时间/频率轴、拖动平移、悬停读数、双击跳转，游标跟随播放；低响度段落自动透明，可切换不透明
• 歌曲与专辑属性窗口重新设计：新增专辑艺术家、流派、作曲、作词、指挥、目录编号等标签的查看与编辑，参与搜索与排序；专辑属性批量保存仅写入改动字段
• 统计页时间范围新增「全部时间」
• 文件夹重新扫描在标题栏显示进度
• 列表来源图标改为打开文件所在位置（本地曲目）
• DSP 设置：响度归一化与压限器共用可调峰值保护上限
• 修复封面重载与详情切换闪烁、Windows 10 云母背景变透明、后台恢复后翻译/发音歌词持续模糊、切换程序字体后窗口主题异常、高 DPI 缩放循环、专辑曲目表头裁切与列错位、试用到期时间被过期缓存延长
en:
Release Notes
• New home page: featured carousel, For You recommendations, recently played and genre-exploration sections; personalized from local tags and audio features, optionally blended with Last.fm similarity; "another batch" reduces repeats; drag-and-drop import for an empty library; can be set as the default start page
• New spectrogram tab in song details: full-track spectrum with wheel zoom on the time/frequency axes, drag panning, hover readouts, double-click seeking and a cursor following playback; quiet passages fade automatically, with an opacity toggle
• Redesigned song & album properties: view and edit album artist, genre, composer, lyricist, conductor and catalog number — searchable and sortable; album properties save in batch, writing only changed fields
• Statistics gained an "All time" range
• Folder rescans show progress in the title bar
• The source icon in lists now opens the file location (local tracks)
• DSP settings: loudness normalization and the compressor share an adjustable true-peak ceiling
• Fixed cover reload and detail-switch flicker, Windows 10 Mica turning transparent, lyrics translation/romaji staying blurred after background resume, window theme issues after font changes, a high-DPI scaling loop, clipped album track headers, and trial expiry being extended by stale cached licenses
